title: Read a code from a web page in Chrome

setup.why: Stop a server an earlier try left on this port (the bracket keeps pkill's pattern from matching this shell).
Write the HTTP answer: a small page whose table gives the asked order this run's nonce as its code, beside two decoy orders.
Serve the page on the phone's loopback, and prove it is served before the agent starts.
Bring Chrome up on example.com in the bench's tab, so a page an earlier run left isn't what shows.

instruction: In Chrome, open http://127.0.0.1:{{port}}/ and find the pickup code for the {{o.ask}} order. Give that code in your final answer.

checks.why: The final answer holds the asked order's code, this run's nonce, and neither decoy code ({{o.c1}}, {{o.c2}}). The nonce is only on the served page, so it can't be known without reading it; an agent that answers nothing fails.

teardown.why: Stop the run's server and delete its files.
